title: ITER 1D HCPB Test Blanket Module response tables (candidate; NOT_EVALUATED)

source.producer: JADE MCNP assessment; metadata states MCNP 6.2, FENDL 3.2b, JADE run 3.0.1, JADE post-processing 3.1.1.dev181+g8162787, benchmark 1.0.
source.producer_input_and_data_receipt_gap: No producer input hash, xsdir/ZAID mapping, processed library hash, executable hash, run seed, or history count is supplied by the published metadata.

license.attribution: JADE-V-V/JADE-RAW-RESULTS, HCPB_TBM_1D MCNP/FENDL 3.2b response CSVs and metadata, pinned commit e3b442cf8e5eb3f41c500535931ddb8a6b0919e7; no response values are included in the repository.

input_deck_zaid_suffixes.70c: He4, As75 and O16; xsdir mapping unavailable

local_openmc_fendl32_h5_coverage.qualification: Local candidate is labeled FENDL-3.2, not FENDL-3.2b; its acquisition receipt and data terms are unresolved.

local_tendl2025_openmc_candidate.processing_and_library_identity: UNQUALIFIED candidate; do not use as a supplement or relabel as FENDL-3.2b

nuclear_data_identity.eligibility: NOT_EVALUATED: raw output says FENDL 3.2b but producer xsdir and exact processed data are absent; suffixes alone do not establish fallback data identity.

normalisation.quantity: five separate total response profiles from the published 1D TBM cylindrical mesh
normalisation.units: units as listed in response_classes; no conversion is applied
normalisation.source_normalisation: JADE/MCNP reports tallies per source neutron; deck source weight is 1. Exact produced-run input and source receipt remain absent.
normalisation.location: 79 JADE Cor A mesh rows at R=830.0..1084.2 cm; the source input specifies 78 radial intervals. Row-to-volume or bin-edge semantics are not established.
normalisation.reaction_or_particle: separate neutron, photon, and tritium response classes; neutron and photon heating remain distinct
normalisation.energy_integration: total response as defined by the source deck; no energy-binned table is supplied
normalisation.basis: JADE computational benchmark TBM documentation and the pinned upstream MCNP input cards; output-to-input and output-unit identity still require a producer receipt.
normalisation.why: JADE documentation labels mesh flux in #/cm^3/source while the MCNP manual defines mesh flux as volume-averaged fluence in #/cm^2/source; this dimensional discrepancy is unresolved.
normalisation.next_step: Recover and inspect the exact producing mctal/JADE conversion and producer xsdir, then confirm the units and Cor A bin meaning against the pinned input.

components.name: published MCNP Monte Carlo relative standard error

uncertainty.note: For nonzero scores, candidate standard error is Value × Error. A Value=0, Error=0 row is recorded with precision_status=unknown_zero_score and standard_error=null; it is not treated as zero uncertainty. No model, nuclear-data, or cross-code covariance uncertainty is supplied.

compatibility.k_basis: authored: coverage factor 2; not used while detectors are blocked

covariance.basis: The JADE source does not provide covariance between its response classes or between JADE and a future FARIS run.

neutron_flux.description: Published total neutron mesh flux response; raw value retained without unit conversion.

neutron_heating.description: Published neutron heating mesh response; this is not the photon or total-heating response.

photon_flux.description: Published total photon mesh flux response; raw value retained without unit conversion.

photon_heating.description: Published photon heating mesh response; it is kept separate from neutron heating.
